description: `private_constant :SECRET` -- 30 sites in the slice, on essentially every constant it declares. It is an ordinary implicit-self `send` in a class body whose *effect* is on the constant environment, so the checker either models it (and rejects an out-of-scope read) or ignores it (and is merely imprecise). Ignoring it is sound; the rung is here to make that a decision rather than an oversight.
